note: Reconciled against merged main bb30bb39, with #790, v2 and #853 merged. The 494 rows and mock decisions remain design history, not approved removals. Chat and the classic interface remain shared; durable atomic behaviors use the canonical behavior-chain journal, not the old work-rehearsal prototype or lossy behavior ledger. Checks identify executable component/browser coverage, not unattended provider acceptance or a claim that each proposed mock control exists. The frozen real campaign and resource proof remain separate obligations in docs/Behavior-chain.md. Gateway pages remain outside the GUI transition.
